title: Hamava 0.2 companion and frontend requirement evidence
interpretation: UI assessments apply only to named rendered behavior and explicit source inspection. They are not replacement product requirement statuses. Reported checks are not unique requirements or comprehensive coverage. Audited states count audit executions and can recur across suites.

technical_checks.production_build: npm run build passed, including TypeScript and Vite, against the hashed frontend/src tree
technical_checks.format: npm run format:check passed; no app source changed afterward
technical_checks.license_notices: The parent-owned prebuild generated notices for 21 locked runtime packages
technical_checks.tool_budget: Synthetic functional tests use TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 on the shared host; production retains 3000 and no latency SLO is inferred
technical_checks.immutable_capture: 61 output files captured immediately in the successful build process; manifests and frontend source/config hashes retained in the final latency-label source-equivalence record.

browser_summary.check_count_definition: Named successful workflow/contract steps; audit totals are executions, not unique screens or requirements
browser_summary.runtime_errors: No errors recorded by the successful suite monitors
browser_summary.http_errors: No unexpected responses in baseline/companion monitors; other workflow response assertions passed. Deliberate 409/503 recovery cases are expected and are not zero-HTTP-error claims.

visual_review.builder: Rendered desktop, 390px and 320px output inspected; screenshot capture resets focus/scroll only after separate functional focus checks.
visual_review.independent: Parent independently inspected actual companion Today at 390 pixels, service connections at desktop width and final setup guide at 320 pixels, accepting readability and semantic hierarchy: phone schedule/tasks lead, persistent navigation is clear, desktop control tabs are readable and four incomplete setup steps are represented honestly. Earlier desktop Costs review accepted its hierarchy and content fit. Earlier review led to mobile schedule-priority and chronological-card refinements. This is rendered browser-viewport review, not physical-device or screen-reader acceptance.
visual_review.artifact_policy: Screenshots are internal review artifacts; sanitized JSON reports are retained as source evidence.
visual_review.contrast_corrections: Navigation group text, companion tab labels and companion explanatory copy were darkened before the predecessor audit. The final correction darkened exactly two setup-summary selectors and one shared mobile clinic-label selector; the affected baseline/companion matrix and six configured/incomplete setup states were rerun.
visual_review.final_latency_labels: The shared latency component has five distinct Persian tool labels. Actual API-backed report rows were checked at 1440/390/320 pixels; the source change adds labels only. Element screenshots can include fixed workspace navigation and checker-induced focus; JSON audits and label/count assertions are the acceptance evidence.

explicit_fixture_boundaries: Companion external-calendar response contract uses injected cached/unknown/verified records, not a live remote provider.
Companion non-demo metadata is a fixture; controlled cost 503 is followed by recovery from the actual local API.
Waitlist stale-policy 409 is deliberately injected for UI recovery; successful bookings use the actual local synthetic API.
Privacy notice race changes actual local policy and receives an actual 409; it is not an injected consent-error response.
RTC lifecycle uses explicit synthetic Room events/API fixtures. Actual network recovery remains partial.
global_acceptance_limits: All current real service interactions use fresh isolated synthetic demo databases. Provider transmission is disabled.
No real customer/patient data, vendor invoice, merchant settlement, carrier transfer, platform send or live-provider qualification is represented.
Axe WCAG2A/AA and WCAG2.1AA-tag audits and selected keyboard checks are bounded evidence, not full accessibility conformance or physical assistive-technology testing.
Desktop Chromium viewport tests do not qualify physical mobile hardware, native WebView/OS storage, microphone/Bluetooth routes, background operation, signing or installed app behavior.
Parent-owned platform, native packaging, backend concurrency/security, supplier UAT, legal and clinical approvals retain separate evidence.
Historical v1 browser-audio/live transport reports remain history and are not included in the current totals.

Interrupted runs are retained separately: an undetermined local ECONNRESET during extensions, an obsolete release-test expectation for the old onboarding heading, and the setup contrast findings that led to the final three-color correction. Failed attempts are not counted as passing evidence; their resolutions link the named reruns.

The final five-label correction received four focused latency checks and a fresh seven-check release rerun. Other suites retain their original bundle/script hashes; the prior release report is archived and excluded from totals. Source-equivalence records distinguish the earlier three-color change from the final label-only change.

The immutable build record retains the detected stale repository-dist read and the initial system-Python launcher failure before any browser/API check. The accepted build and both successful suites used the verified capture and project virtual environment.

requirements.title: RTL responsive console
observed_browser_behavior: The built Persian RTL workspace and public pages were audited at desktop, 390px and 320px; named states have no horizontal document overflow.
Mobile Today leads with the schedule; chronological appointment cards and bottom navigation clearance were exercised at both narrow widths.
implemented_and_inspected: Mixed Latin identifiers use appropriate direction and local Vazirmatn typography.
acceptance_limits: Browser viewports are not physical Android/iOS or screen-reader qualification.
requirements.scope: Frontend contribution only; this does not replace the main requirement assessment or backend, provider and physical-device evidence.

acceptance_limits: Configuration and an empty local call queue do not establish live provider health or staffed pickup capacity.
